## What WA Coders is

WA Coders is a software house with offices in Miami, FL (601 Brickell Key Drive, Miami, FL 33131) and São Paulo, Brazil (1550 Av. Chucri Zaidan). It works with companies in the United States, Europe and Brazil. The team is senior, with professionals who have more than 10 years of experience, working in time zones that overlap with the US and Europe, communicating fluently in English and documenting every handoff.

6. Integrations & Modernization. Connecting CRM, payment gateways, ERP or any third-party system, and migrating legacy platforms to modern stacks without disrupting operations.
7. SAP & CRM Customization. See the section below.

## SAP Business One and CRM C4C customization (https://www.wacoders.com/en/sap-crm/)

SAP Business One and CRM systems hold the data a company needs, but are not built for a quick, everyday look at what matters. WA Coders builds a customization layer on top of the client's existing SAP Business One and SAP CRM (C4C) data, so teams consult reports, payments, clients and projects without digging through menus or exporting spreadsheets. It does not replace SAP: it connects and organizes what SAP already processes, with no data migration.

Every implementation starts from Opportunity, WA Coders' own production-tested platform, and is tailored to the client's approval workflows, rules and branding.

What it covers:
- Payments approved by authority level: requested → receipt attached → approval by configurable authority level → paid. Approved payments become payment documents in SAP B1 automatically, with a complete audit trail.
- Integrations: SAP Business One (payments and suppliers, no duplicate records) and SAP C4C (projects and customer accounts synchronized automatically, so each payment links to the right project, budget and client).
- Six dashboard modules: Pipeline & CRM, Finance, Projects, KPIs by area, Timesheet, Commercial dashboards.
- Reports and dashboards pulled straight from SAP, with no manual exports.
- Security and audit: every payment, approval and receipt is logged with user, role and date; JWT authentication; role-based permissions; attached receipts.
- Multi-company view in a single dashboard for groups with more than one legal entity.

## Products built by WA Coders

- Opportunity — https://www.getopportunity.com.br/ — payment request and approval platform built natively on SAP Business One and SAP C4C.
- JuriOne — https://jurione.com.br/ — AI-powered legal practice management: automated petition drafting, case and deadline tracking, client and contract management, billing. Law firms report saving up to 4 hours a day.
- Upsee — https://www.upsee.com.br/ — AI computer vision for retail analytics: foot traffic, visitor demographics and conversion metrics from in-store cameras.

## FAQ

Q: How does the WA Coders nearshore model work?
A: A senior team with offices in Miami and São Paulo, working in the client's time zone in the US, Europe or Brazil, with real-time collaboration, fluent English communication and documented handoffs.

Q: How do I hire a dedicated team?
A: Senior engineers join the client's team on a flexible monthly contract, with no recruiting process or long-term commitment.

Q: How do I request a quote?
A: Use the contact form or WhatsApp. WA Coders replies in less than 24 hours.

Q: Does WA Coders customize SAP Business One and CRM C4C?
A: Yes, starting from the Opportunity platform and tailored to the client's workflows, rules and branding.
